chapter_title_en: Winds Stir Beyond the Seas, a Glimmer of Hope
chapter_seo_title: A Record of a Mortal’s Journey – Ch. 515: Winds Stir Beyond the Seas
chapter_meta_description: Han Li returns to Heaven Star City to find war approaching. His escape hinges on a guarded teleportation array and an overheard bribe—will his plan hold before the Void Heaven Cauldron secret leaks?
og_title: Han Li’s Escape Plan Takes Shape – A Mortal’s Journey Ch. 515
og_description: Back from the Void Heaven Palace, Han Li scouts the teleportation array and overhears a crucial conversation. The war is coming, and he must move fast.
twitter_title: Mortal Journey 515 – Han Li Plans His Great Escape
twitter_description: Teleportation doesn’t come cheap: 5000 spirit stones per head. Han Li overhears a bribe and starts calculating his way out of Heaven Star City.

lore_anchors.definition: The central city of the Chaotic Star Sea, built at the foot of Sacred Mountain and ruled by Star Palace; currently under martial law due to the looming war.
The tiered mountain at the heart of Heaven Star City, with numbered layers corresponding to restricted access for cultivators of different ranks.
The hall on the 50th layer of Sacred Mountain that houses the teleportation array to the Outer Star Seas.
The lawless frontier region beyond the Inner Star Seas, teeming with rogue cultivators, demon beasts, and ancient ruins.
A private telepathic communication method used by cultivators; can be eavesdropped upon only by those with vastly superior spiritual sense or rare secret arts.
Han Li’s prized spirit insects, which he has been raising for years; their swarm-based devouring ability makes them a powerful tactical asset.
